newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skandia to release Stadshypotek info soon.
newsitem.headline: Skandia to release Stadshypotek info soon.

text.p: Swedish insurer Skandia will probably release information to the market concerning its bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek late on Tuesday or early Wednesday, a company spokesamn said.
"I don't think (the information) will come out until late as the board will be in a meeting all day Tuesday," spokesman Anders Lundblad told Reuters.
"It is likely that it will come early on Wednesday."
Skandia and Stadshypotek put forward a proposed merger on November 25 that has been strongly opposed by the government that holds a 34 percent stake in the mortgage bank.
But last week Handelsbanken announced a 22.9 billion crown takeover bid for Stadshypotek which puts a higher value on the mortgage lender.

A Skandia spokesman last week said it was reviewing the new situation and continuing work on its merger prospectus but would release more information before an extraordinary shareholders meeting on December 19.
